name: krea-2/txt2img
description: Krea-2 text to image. Positive prompt only (the negative is zeroed out). The base for most Krea-2 images.

name: krea-2/txt2img-upscale
description: Krea-2 text to image, then an upscale (CR Upscale Image).

name: krea-2/txt2img-detailer-upscale
description: Krea-2 text to image, three FaceDetailer passes (the face and two body regions), then an upscale.

name: krea-2/txt2img-detailer-hires
description: Krea-2 text to image, an upscale with a model and a tiled VAE re-encode, then three FaceDetailer passes.

name: krea-2/face-detail-image
description: Works on an input image (pass it with input_images): removes the background and refines the face with FaceDetailer. Made for character sprites.

name: illustrious/txt2img
description: Illustrious (SDXL) checkpoint text to image, with positive and negative prompts.

name: illustrious/txt2img-detailer-upscale
description: Illustrious text to image, three FaceDetailer passes, then an upscale.
